description: A smartphone rests on a textured white surface next to a stylized paper craft resembling a calendar page. The phone screen shows a productivity app titled My Day for Friday, December 4, listing incomplete tasks like packing and completed items such as booking tickets and accepting an invite. A blue paper streamer curl sits in the upper corner of the scene.
